title: Sign and magnitude instability: does the same concept vector help in one direction and harm in the reverse?

original_idea.body: Sweep positive and negative coefficients symmetrically; test whether suppression is as clean as promotion per concept. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: suppression-based safety fragility matters, but catastrophic-risk link is indirect (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Symmetric coefficient sweep + behavior scoring; clear methodology, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped sweep (+/- coefficients, one concept) with clear metrics (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly reliability finding on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Dose-response asymmetry partly studied; per-concept +/- characterization may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Asymmetry noted in dose-response work; the per-concept sign characterization may be open.
